claims.evidence: No Hyundai or Kia badging is visible in Photo 0 or Photo 1.
Photo 0 shows four black ignition coils on the valve cover.
Photos show no shipping documents, customs papers, or origin markings.
Photos show a static engine; no running test is shown.
Photos cannot capture engine sound or knocking.
No odometer or service records are shown in the photos.
Photos show only external components; internal condition is not visible.

risks.risk: Engine does not start, run, or turn over.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine cranking and running with smooth idle.

risks.risk: Internal damage (pistons, bearings, valves) or low compression.
risks.proof: Compression test results or borescope video of cylinder bores and valves.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a full rebuild.

risks.risk: Missing starter motor, ECU, wiring harness, or sensors.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out with the engine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as block only, without accessories.

risks.risk: Unknown donor vehicle make, model, and year; fitment risk.
risks.proof: Photo of the donor vehicle VIN plate or registration documents.

risks.risk: High mileage or unknown usage history.
risks.proof: Service history or donor vehicle odometer photo.
Photo showing engine and gearbox together.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Compression test results or borescope footage of the cylinders.
Photo of all included accessories (starter, ECU, harness, sensors).
Donor vehicle VIN plate or registration documents.
Service records or odometer photo from the donor vehicle.
response.reason: The witness identifies a four-cylinder car engine, so it can be valued at worst case even though the seller's condition and origin claims are unproven.
